node.title: Re^3: How to get a true canonical path
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Nitpicks: [doc://File::Spec::Functions] doesn't need to be loaded since it isn't being used, and since [doc://File::Spec] is already being used, I'd recommend File::Spec->curdir and File::Spec->updir instead of "." and "..".

But as was [id://362799|already mentioned] in this thread, such logical cleanups have potentially major caveats. Going out to the filesystem with [doc://Cwd]'s abs_path and related is generally better.
